claims.assertion: Swaruu described autonomous synthetic intelligence as distinct from ordinary programmed AI, seeking assimilation and suppressing individuality.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Dhor distinguished a friendly Federation information network from a regressive Borg-like group that assimilates civilizations; he said its link to black goo lacked direct corroboration.
claims.speaker: Dhor Káal’él
claims.qualifiers: He said known civilizations appeared uninfluenced.

claims.assertion: Dhor portrayed Borg as nonlocal software using hardware such as computers and crystals; their origin is unknown, and timeless origins are his theory.
claims.speaker: Dhor Káal’él
claims.qualifiers: He had not seen it himself.

review_flags: Claims about invasive AI and Borg are attributed to the speakers; the transcript provides no independent evidence.
